title: Battery Cell Contact Monitoring
text: Monitor for battery cell contact, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Time constant for voltage change smoothing (s)}, {Threshold for voltage change detection (dV/dt)}, {Allowed voltage change peak-to-average ratio} sets the allowed peak-to-average ratio of voltage, {Cumulative error threshold}, {Qualification time (s)} sets the time to qualify contact loss error, {Disqualification time (s)} sets the time to disqualify contact loss error and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CellConnectionError
ports.summary: Indication of contact loss error, unitless vector

ports.name: CellConnectionSymptom
ports.summary: Indication of contact loss symptom, unitless vector

params.name: Time constant for voltage change smoothing (s)
params.values: Time constant for voltage change smoothing 10 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Threshold for voltage change detection (dV/dt)
params.values: Threshold for voltage change detection 5e-4 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Allowed voltage change peak-to-average ratio
params.values: Allowed peak-to-average ratio of voltage change 0.02 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Cumulative error threshold
params.values: Cumulative error threshold for contact loss symptom 1e-4 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Qualification time (s)
params.values: Time to qualify contact loss error 20 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Disqualification time (s)
params.values: Time to disqualify contact loss error 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
